spp.descriptionHtml:
A small sun rising at the throat. One round clear cubic zirconia of about 5.5mm sits up in gold claws, and seven slender polished gold tone petals fan out below it like rays, about 18mm across in all, on a fine snake chain.

STYLING TIP: Let it sit alone on a plain neckline, so the petals catch the light.

Details

  • Pendant: Approximately 18mm across, seven open polished petals fanned below the stone
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 5.5mm, in a claw setting
  • Chain: Fine snake chain with a lobster clasp and extender
  • Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
  • Metal: Gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

htn.descriptionHtml:
A polished V and one clear drop. A dense gold tone wheat chain about 3.5mm wide, its small bright cut links set in a tight chevron, turns into two smooth gold tone bars that meet in a V at the front, and a pear cut clear cubic zirconia of about 10 x 14mm hangs point up from the point of the V.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone with a white top or a deep neckline.

Details

  • Chain: Dense wheat chain of small bright cut links set in a chevron, approximately 3.5mm wide
  • Front: Two polished bars, approximately 17mm each, meeting in a V
  • Drop: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 10 x 14mm, hanging point up in a claw setting
  • Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
  • Material: 316L stainless steel with a PVD gold tone finish, as labelled by the supplier

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

pohs.descriptionHtml:
A heart drawn in light. Each stud is a bold open heart of about 23mm in polished gold tone, its broad outline set with two rows of tiny clear cubic zirconia, with the centre left open.

STYLING TIP: Pair them with the Pearl Heart Layered Necklace.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 23mm across and 22mm tall
  • Stones: Two rows of tiny clear cubic zirconia round the outline
  • Fitting: Stud
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

clgn.descriptionHtml:
A garland of red clovers. Small four petal clovers, each four round red stones in gold tone cups with a fine beaded rim around one small clear stone at the centre, are linked petal to petal by fine gold rings all the way round the neck.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone with an open neckline, or with the Clover Garland Bracelet in white.

Details

  • Clovers: Approximately 8.5mm across, linked petal to petal by small gold tone rings
  • Stones: Four round red cubic zirconia petals per clover, approximately 3mm, around a small clear centre stone
  • Colour: Red
  • Setting: Gold tone cups with a fine beaded rim
  • Length: Approximately 42cm (to confirm)
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

clg.descriptionHtml:
A garland of tiny clovers. Fifteen small four petal clovers, each four round stones in gold tone cups with a fine beaded rim around one small clear stone at the centre, are linked petal to petal by fine gold rings, so the line moves softly with the wrist. In sky blue, rose pink or clear white.

STYLING TIP: Wear one alone, or the sky blue and the pink together on one wrist.

Details

  • Clovers: Fifteen, approximately 8.5mm across, linked petal to petal by small gold tone rings
  • Stones: Four round cubic zirconia petals per clover, approximately 3mm, around a small clear centre stone
  • Colours: Sky Blue, Pink or White
  • Setting: Gold tone cups with a fine beaded rim
  • Length: Approximately 17cm, adjustable to about 21cm with the extender
  • Closure: Lobster clasp with an extender chain
  • Metal: Stainless steel, polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
